title: Export download links
text: An administrator can export customer records as a CSV archive from Settings > Data > Export. Export download links expire after 48 hours. Generate a new export if the download link has expired.

title: Support opening hours
text: The support team handles requests Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00 UTC. Include your workspace ID and the steps that led to the problem. The team does not promise a fixed resolution time.
